name: Senmiao Technology Limited Common Stock
description: Senmiao Technology Ltd is a holding company. Along with its subsidiaries, it is engaged in facilitating automobile transactions and offering related services. The group's business activities include providing car rental services to individual customers with lease term no more than twelve months; leasing and servicing of new energy vehicles; offering services to automobile purchasers throughout the purchase process; providing management and related services to Partner Platforms and other companies; automobile financing; and providing other related supporting services to customers. The majority of the group's revenue is generated from its automobile rental business.
